newsitem.title: USA: Detonations heard at possible Cunanan siege site.
newsitem.headline: Detonations heard at possible Cunanan siege site.

text.p: Several detonations were heard at the site of a police siege in Miami Beach on Wednesday night, possibly involving Andrew Cunanan, suspected in the killing of Italian designer Gianni Versace, witnesses said.
It was not clear if the detonations were gunshots but some came from police positions, the witnesses said.
Two Reuter journalists said they heard five or six detonations.
There was no sign that police were storming the site, a houseboat moored on an inland waterway on Miami Beach.
